description: This Java class defines an Entity Event-Condition-Action (ECA) rule for Apache OFBiz framework. It encapsulates logic for evaluating conditions and executing actions on entity events, such as create, update, or delete, with associated configuration and execution logic.

classes.name: EntityEcaRule
classes.description: Represents an Entity-Event Condition-Action rule for Apache OFBiz. Handles evaluation of conditions and execution of actions based on entity events.

methods.name: EntityEcaRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an EntityEcaRule object by parsing its configuration from an XML Element.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity this rule applies to.

methods.name: getOperationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation this rule applies to.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the name of the event this rule is associated with.

methods.name: getRunOnError
methods.description: Indicates whether the rule runs on error conditions.

methods.name: getActionsAndSets
methods.description: Returns the list of actions and set operations associated with this rule.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of conditions that must be satisfied for the actions to execute.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the rule against the current operation, context, entity value, error state, and actions already run. Executes actions if conditions are met.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Deprecated method to set whether the rule is enabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the rule is enabled.
